digest.component_or_area: CLI argument parser and advanced command infrastructure
propositions: Advanced command grammars in bridge, reconciler, audit, LLM, workflow, identity, and gate commands currently use inline argparse construction with manual dispatch causing unsafe/incomplete help forms
Argparse parser factories must be extracted into reusable S2a side-effect-free modules that import no optional runtimes (Pydantic AI, FastAPI, Jira transport, workflow executor, metrics, tracing)
Parse-failure handling must be reconciled so ParseError raised by RebarArgumentParser.error() is caught identically to current SystemExit(2) behavior with preserved exit codes and stderr/usage bytes

Parser factories must support optional keyword passthroughs (usage, add_help, formatter_class) to preserve bespoke presentation for verify-opcert, verify-commit, verify-authorship, remote-cert, trusted-env, and nested bridge parsers
All advanced routes must have valid factory references and be deterministically generation-ready without executing handlers or importing optional runtimes
Canonical and compatibility bridge spellings must share argument-definition helpers while preserving prog, replacement, visibility, and historical usage behavior
